subject: History
assessment_title: History Grade 12 Term 3 Controlled Assessment Pack

visual_blueprint.subject: History
assessment_content_focus: civil society protest, civil rights, Black Power and resistance to apartheid
oral testimony, speeches, photographs and political cartoons
evidence-based essay on resistance movements and impact
generation_constraints: Every question must be answerable from the stated term focus, supplied stimulus and grade-appropriate subject knowledge.
Educator approval is required before classroom use.

sections.title: Section A: Source-Based Questions
sections.instructions: Use the supplied historical source set.
sections.stimulus: Source set on civil society protest, civil rights, Black Power and resistance to apartheid. Each source must include provenance.

questions.question: Contextualise the source in relation to the historical topic.
Explain the message or viewpoint of the source using evidence.
Evaluate the usefulness or reliability of the source.

sections.title: Section B: Comparison And Causation
sections.stimulus: Evidence focus: bias, reliability, limitation and corroboration.

questions.question: Compare two sources and explain where they agree or differ.
Explain one cause and one consequence linked to the topic.

sections.title: Section C: Essay Paragraph
sections.stimulus: Essay focus: evidence-based essay on resistance movements and impact.

questions.question: Write a structured historical paragraph with a clear claim, evidence and judgement.

rubric.descriptor: Answers are clear, complete and structured.

teacher_review_checklist: Confirm CAPS term and topic fit before classroom use.
Insert or approve final source material where the pack requests educator-supplied sources.
Check mark allocation, memo wording and learner level.
Confirm visuals are suitable and not treated as official source material unless sourced separately.
